description: We use an automated tool that screens CVs and ranks job applicants for our recruiters, who normally interview the top ten.
rationale: The tool screens CVs and ranks applicants to decide who recruiters interview, which matches Annex III point 4(a) on analysing and filtering job applications and evaluating candidates. Ranking applicants is also profiling, which Art 6(3) says keeps an Annex III system high-risk.

answer:
Triage result

Proposed tier: high (confidence 0.95). The tool screens CVs and ranks applicants to decide who recruiters interview, which matches Annex III point 4(a) on analysing and filtering job applications and evaluating candidates. Ranking applicants is also profiling, which Art 6(3) says keeps an Annex III system high-risk.
Basis: "(a) AI systems intended to be used for the recruitment or selection of natural persons, in particular to place targeted job advertisements, to analyse and filter job applications, and to evaluate candidates;" [ai-act/anx-III#2]

Obligations (each quote verified verbatim):
- Use the system in accordance with the provider's instructions for use, with appropriate technical and organisational measures. [ai-act/art-26#1] "Deployers of high-risk AI systems shall take appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure they use such systems in accordance with the instructions for use accompanying the systems"
- Assign human oversight to people with the necessary competence, training and authority. [ai-act/art-26#1] "Deployers shall assign human oversight to natural persons who have the necessary competence, training and authority"
- Where you control the input data, ensure it is relevant and sufficiently representative for the intended purpose. [ai-act/art-26#1] "that deployer shall ensure that input data is relevant and sufficiently representative"
- As an employer, inform workers' representatives and affected workers before putting the system into service that they will be subject to it. [ai-act/art-26#3] "shall inform workers’ representatives and the affected workers that they will be subject to the use of the high-risk AI system"
- Inform the candidates or natural persons concerned that they are subject to the system's use in decisions. [ai-act/art-26#5] "shall inform the natural persons that they are subject to the use of the high-risk AI system"
- Monitor the system's operation based on the instructions for use, and suspend use and notify the provider and authority if a risk is suspected. [ai-act/art-26#2] "Deployers shall monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system on the basis of the instructions for use"
- Keep the automatically generated logs under your control for at least six months, unless other law requires otherwise. [ai-act/art-26#2] "Deployers of high-risk AI systems shall keep the logs automatically generated by that high-risk AI system"
- Where decisions are based solely on automated processing and significantly affect individuals, provide the right to human intervention, to express a view, and to contest the decision. [gdpr/art-22#1] "the right to obtain human intervention on the part of the controller, to express his or her point of view and to contest the decision"
